steps.tx: **Rabies kills virtually every encephalitic patient**; prevention after exposure is the only cure. **Dog bites cause most Indian cases**; bats, monkeys and wild carnivores add the rest. **Virus climbs nerves to brain** over weeks to months; **shorter distance means shorter incubation**. **Hydrophobia with aerophobia** marks furious rabies. **No antiviral works** once symptoms start; **ICU only prolongs dying**. **PEP started in time prevents all** deaths.
steps.say: Rabies was reported to kill virtually every encephalitic patient, while prevention after exposure stayed the only cure. Dog bites were reported to cause most Indian cases, while bats, monkeys and wild carnivores added the rest. Virus was reported to climb nerves to brain over weeks to months, while shorter distance meant shorter incubation. Hydrophobia with aerophobia was reported to mark furious rabies. No antiviral was reported to work once symptoms started, while I C U only prolonged dying. P E P started in time was reported to prevent all deaths.

steps.tx: **Category I (touch, licks intact skin)** needs washing only. **Category II (nibbles, scratches, no bleed)** needs wound care plus vaccine. **Category III (bites, bleeding scratches, licks on broken skin or mucosa)** needs wound care plus vaccine plus immunoglobulin. **Any bleed is Category III**; **all wild bites are Category III**. **Rat, hare and rabbit bites** ordinarily skip PEP. **Give PEP whatever the delay**; months late still counts.
steps.say: Category one with touch and licks on intact skin was reported to need washing only. Category two with nibbles and scratches without bleed was reported to need wound care plus vaccine. Category three with bites, bleeding scratches and licks on broken skin or mucosa was reported to need wound care plus vaccine plus immunoglobulin. Any bleed was defined as Category three, while all wild bites stayed Category three. Rat, hare and rabbit bites were reported to ordinarily skip P E P. Giving P E P whatever the delay was advised, as months late still counted.

steps.tx: **Wash every wound 15 minutes** with soap and running water, even if late; **flush eyes with water**. **Povidone-iodine after washing** kills residual virus; **never chillies, oil or herbs**. **Do not suture primarily**; infiltrate RIG first, wait hours, then loose stitches if forced. **Tetanus with antibiotics** where the wound needs them. **Washing alone halves risk**; never skip it for vaccine.
steps.say: Washing every wound fifteen minutes with soap and running water was ordered even if late, while eyes were flushed with water. Povidone-iodine after washing was reported to kill residual virus, while chillies, oil and herbs were never advised. Primary suturing was never advised, while R I G was infiltrated first with hours waited and loose stitches if forced. Tetanus with antibiotics was reported where the wound needed them. Washing alone was reported to halve risk, so skipping it for vaccine was never advised.

steps.tx: **RIG for every Category III** (and Category II if immunocompromised); **skip only with documented prior full PEP or PrEP**. **ERIG 40 IU/kg or HRIG 20 IU/kg** is the maximum dose; **no skin test** needed. **Infiltrate all wounds**, diluting 2 to 3 fold with saline if volume falls short; **never gluteal, never IV, never with vaccine**. **Give with first dose or within 7 days**; later adds nothing. **Rabies monoclonal antibody** is a licensed alternative dosed by label.
steps.say: R I G for every Category three and Category two if immunocompromised was ordered, while skipping was allowed only with documented prior full P E P or Pr E P. E R I G forty I U per kilo or H R I G twenty I U per kilo was defined as the maximum dose, while no skin test was needed. Infiltrating all wounds was ordered, diluting two to three fold with saline if volume fell short, while gluteal, I V and vaccine-site injection were never advised. Giving with the first dose or within seven days was ordered, as later added nothing. Rabies monoclonal antibody was reported as a licensed alternative dosed by label.

steps.tx: **Thai Red Cross ID is preferred**: two deltoid spots receive 0.1 mL each on days 0, 3, 7 and 28. **Essen IM uses one full vial** on days 0, 3, 7, 14 and 28. **Deltoid in all** (thigh in infants), never gluteal, same dose at every age. **Delays of a day or two continue the course**; the first three doses land within ten days. **Chloroquine or steroid users take the IM route**. **Previously fully vaccinated re-exposures need only days 0 and 3** without RIG; washing alone suffices inside three months.
steps.say: Thai Red Cross I D was preferred, as two deltoid spots received zero point one m L each on days nought, three, seven and twenty eight. Essen I M was reported to use one full vial on days nought, three, seven, fourteen and twenty eight. Deltoid in all was ordered, never gluteal. Delays of a day or two were reported to continue the course. Chloroquine or steroid users were reported to take the I M route. Previously fully vaccinated re-exposures were reported to need only days nought and three without R I G, while washing alone sufficed inside three months.

steps.tx: **Furious rabies** rages with hydrophobia, aerophobia and agitation alternating lucidity; **dumb rabies** paralyses quietly and is missed. **Incubation 20 to 90 days** typically, shorter with face bites. **Prodrome tingles at the healed wound** before encephalitis. **Autonomic storms** swing pulse with pressure. **Coma with death in days** follows onset; **survival anecdotes lack proof**. **Negri bodies are obsolete**; diagnosis is clinical with lab support.
steps.say: Furious rabies was reported to rage with hydrophobia, aerophobia and agitation alternating lucidity, while dumb rabies paralysed quietly and was missed. Incubation twenty to ninety days typically was reported, with shorter course for face bites. Prodrome tingling at the healed wound was reported before encephalitis. Autonomic storms were reported to swing pulse with pressure. Coma with death in days was reported to follow onset, while survival anecdotes lacked proof. Negri bodies were defined as obsolete, while diagnosis stayed clinical with lab support.

steps.tx: **Nuchal skin PCR with saliva PCR** diagnoses ante-mortem; **repeat as load rises**. **Corneal smear with serum antibodies** support late cases. **Brain biopsy post-mortem** confirms with Negri bodies. **Dog observation 10 days** converts IM courses to PrEP only; **ID courses finish fully**. **The 10-day rule never applies** to wild animals. **Treat the patient, test contacts** exposed to secretions as precaution.
steps.say: Nuchal skin P C R with saliva P C R was ordered to diagnose ante-mortem, while repeating was advised as load rose. Corneal smear with serum antibodies was reported to support late cases. Brain biopsy post-mortem was reported to confirm with Negri bodies. Dog observation for ten days was reported to convert I M courses to Pr E P only, while I D courses finished fully. The ten-day rule was reported to never apply to wild animals. Treating the patient was advised, while contacts exposed to secretions were tested as precaution.

steps.tx: **Milwaukee coma protocol never proved**; palliation replaces heroics once encephalitic. **Pregnancy, infancy and old age never block PEP**; give full doses. **Immunocompromised get RIG for Category II too**, full IM course, and **antibody check 14 days after (0.5 IU/mL adequate)**. **PrEP on days 0 and 7 with day 21 or 28** shields lab with vet staff; **boost below 0.5 IU/mL**. **Close contacts of patients** get PEP only if secretion-exposed.
steps.say: Milwaukee coma protocol was reported to never prove itself, while palliation replaced heroics once encephalitic. Pregnancy, infancy and old age were defined to never block P E P, while full doses were given. Immunocompromised were reported to get R I G for Category two too, with full I M course and antibody check fourteen days after, adequate at zero point five I U per m L. Pr E P on days nought and seven with day twenty one or twenty eight was reported to shield lab with vet staff, while boosting below zero point five I U per m L was advised. Close contacts of patients were reported to get P E P only if secretion-exposed.

steps.tx: **Exam traps:** waiting for the dog to die wastes the window; start at once. **Omitting RIG in Category III** kills; IM RIG at distant sites wastes it. **Suturing before RIG** traps virus. **Restarting after a missed dose** is wrong; continue the schedule. **Gluteal vaccine** fails; deltoid only. **Bat exposures skip routine PEP in India** per NCDC; wild bites always count. **Nerve-tissue vaccine history** earns full modern PEP.
steps.say: For the exam, these traps were tabulated as requested. Waiting for the dog to die was reported to waste the window, while starting at once was advised. Omitting R I G in Category three was reported to kill, while I M R I G at distant sites wasted it. Suturing before R I G was reported to trap virus. Restarting after a missed dose was reported as wrong, while continuing the schedule was advised. Gluteal vaccine was reported to fail, while deltoid only was advised. Bat exposures were reported to skip routine P E P in India per N C D C, while wild bites always counted. Nerve-tissue vaccine history was reported to earn full modern P E P.

steps.tx: **High yield for the exam:** **Category III needs RIG plus vaccine**; **Category II vaccine alone**. **Wash 15 minutes** first. **ERIG 40 IU/kg, HRIG 20 IU/kg** into wounds, **within 7 days**. **ID on days 0, 3, 7 and 28 (0.1 mL, 2 sites)**; **IM on days 0, 3, 7, 14 and 28**. **Hydrophobia** marks furious rabies. **Nuchal PCR** diagnoses. **PrEP 0, 7, 21/28** for lab staff.
steps.say: For the exam, these high-yield facts were tabulated as requested. Category three was reported to need R I G plus vaccine, while Category two needed vaccine alone. Washing fifteen minutes was ordered first. E R I G forty I U per kilo and H R I G twenty I U per kilo into wounds within seven days were ordered. I D on days nought, three, seven and twenty eight was ordered, as was I M to day twenty eight. Hydrophobia was reported to mark furious rabies. Nuchal P C R was reported to diagnose. Pr E P nought, seven, twenty one or twenty eight was reported for lab staff.
